Most northerners live in the fertile Elendel Basin near the equator, ringed by the Seran, Faleast and Channerel mountains, where there are railways, electric lights and early cars. Around the Basin lie the Roughs, and near the south pole a colder southern continent.

Prisoners crawl into the cracks to find atium geodes and seldom last a year. Kelsier survived here when his wife did not. At the end of the trilogy Elend makes his last stand here against the koloss.
Rock walls and a canyon-like approach make the city hard to take. Elend’s army besieges it, and Yomen’s raid destroys half his koloss.

The koloss break in
The koloss storm Luthadel and Clubs, Dockson and Tindwyl are among the dead. Vin returns, takes control of the koloss and turns them on Straff’s army.
Elend fights the koloss at the Pits of Hathsin, above the hidden atium, and dies there. His soldiers burn the atium so Ruin can never have it.
